interpretation: 16.18: 'kagō de soi legō hoti sy ei Petros, kai epi tautē tē petra oikodomēsō mou tēn ekklēsian'; 16.19: 'dōsō soi tas kleidas tēs basileias tōn ouranōn', with binding (dēsēs) and loosing (lysēs) on earth ratified in heaven. Read as a report of a promise to Peter, in the future tense (oikodomēsō, dōsō), of building Jesus' own ekklēsia on him and of the keys with the power to bind and loose; CommissionReport.powers mt16 = [keys, bindAndLoose]. Context read: 16.13-17 (the confession, revealed by the Father) and 16.20-23 (the command of silence and the rebuke of Peter). Limits: textual report only; it is a promise, not a narrated conferral; the recipient is Peter alone; whether 'this rock' is Peter, his confession or Christ is a reading not needed here, since only the named powers are encoded; and the verse's authenticity is disputed in critical scholarship, which is the content of the report-to-event premise, not of this claim.
